## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 48 captures during July 2022. This provides the activity level for the reporting period and forms the basis for the image-quality and grading results set out below.

## Image quality

Of the 48 captures, 3 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.2 per cent. These captures could not be used for grading and should be considered when reviewing the overall performance for the month. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues continue to be logged with the service desk, so that any persistent equipment or image-capture problems can be identified and addressed.

## Grading

A total of 9 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 25. This result should be considered alongside the image-quality findings, including the 3 ungradable captures. Monitoring activity, image quality and grading outcomes together will support ongoing review of the service at Oakridge Primary Care. Future reports should continue to record recurring camera issues through the service desk and track whether the image-quality position changes over subsequent reporting periods.
